'''Urnon Mossu''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and member of the [[Blank Look Gang]] during the [[Rise of the Empire era]].

At some point during his time as a member of the Blankers he, [[Hewpaj]], and an unidentified female member of the gang were sent to steal a collection of [[antique Twi'lek pots]] from the [[Galactic Museum/Legends|Galactic Museum]] in [[CoCo Town/Legends|CoCo Town]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] for an anonymous wealthy client from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. After their [[Gender/Legends|female]] partner infiltrated the museum and reprogrammed a [[ASP-7 labor droid/Legends|ASP-7 labor droid]] to bring the pots to the museum's landing dock, Urnon's job was to wait below the dock in a stolen [[Speeder/Legends|hotrod]] speeder. The droid was programmed to then walk off the dock and fall into the waiting speeder below, at which point Urnon would pick up [[Hewpaj]], who would've caused a distraction with his [[Sniper rifle/Legends|sniper rifle]] and the pair would make a hasty getaway. However, a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] had been hired to keep watch for such heist and attempted to stop the robbery. They eventually succeeded when, after a speeder chase, Urnon crashed his speeder into a [[Pierceskimmer]]'s tank in the [[Royal Icqui Aquaria]], where he was likely killed by the beast, along with [[Hewpaj]].

==Personality and traits==
Urnon was a fairly skilled pilot and could perform a large number of tricks and stunts with ease, which he used to try and lose his followers during the escape from the museum.

==Behind the scenes==
Urnon Mossu was a character in the [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Saga Edition Core Rulebook|saga edition]] [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]] mini-adventure [[Art For Art's Sake]], so the above biography assumes the adventure is completed as suggested in the article.
